prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: Many a prospective investor (A) / have sustained heavy losses (B) / due to the sudden crash of the unregulated cryptocurrency market. (C) / No Error (D)
options: due to the sudden crash of the unregulated cryptocurrency market. (C)
explanation: 'Many a + singular noun' always takes a singular verb, so 'have sustained' should be 'has sustained'.
